[NFCT.4.5] **The lifecycles are the registry `specs/registry/schema_lifecycle.ebnf`.**
`ds_schema_lifecycle_t` must mirror it name for name and value for value. A
lifecycle says how a fact of the schema leaves working memory ([NFCT.4.1]), and
`INTERNAL` marks a schema the engine owns ([NDBG.2.2]). It is not the scope an
artefact declares (`proto/schema_logical.proto#SchemaLifecycle`): a schema the
artefact declares `explicit`, `logical` or `activation` reads as `LOGICAL`.
